headline: On November 26, 2008: QE2 docks in Dubai
captionCards: Laid up until converted into a floating hotel in Dubai
Still stands as a testament to transatlantic travel heritage
instagramCaption:
QE2 arrives in Dubai after her final voyage.

The ocean liner Queen Elizabeth 2, built in Scotland, ended her service in 2008. She docked in Dubai to be converted into a floating hotel. Her last transatlantic crossing marked the end of an era for Cunard Line.

She remains a symbol of mid-20th-century maritime luxury.
